dct_description_sm: Road map of the state of New Jersey from the N.J. Geological Survey under the direction of Edwin A. Stevens, Commissioner of Public Roads; Robert A. Meeker, State Highway Engineer and Henry B. Kummel, State Geologist. Roads designated in red solid or dashed lines as improved with state aid, improved without state aid or as turnpikes.
